mapper.select: SELECT ci.id AS id, ci.product_id AS productId, ci.sku_id AS skuId, ci.quantity AS quantity, ci.create_time AS createTime, ci.update_time AS updateTime, p.spu_code AS spuCode, p.unit AS unit, p.status AS productStatus, p.sys_org_code AS productOrgCode, p.del_flag AS productDelFlag, COALESCE(t.title, tz.title, p.spu_code) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.cover_url, ''), NULLIF(tz.cover_url, ''), p.main_image) AS coverUrl, c.sku_code AS skuCode, c.combination_name AS skuName, c.saleable AS skuSaleable, c.del_flag AS skuDelFlag, COALESCE(c.price, p.price) AS price, COALESCE(c.stock, p.stock) AS stock, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ck_shop_product_sku_combination x WHERE x.product_id = ci.product_id AND x.del_flag = 0) AS skuTypeCount FROM ck_shop_cart_item ci LEFT JOIN ck_shop_product p ON p.id = ci.product_id LEFT JOIN ck_shop_product_translation t ON t.product_id = ci.product_id AND t.language_code = #{lang} LEFT JOIN ck_shop_product_translation tz ON tz.product_id = ci.product_id AND tz.language_code = #{defaultLang} LEFT JOIN ck_shop_product_sku_combination c ON c.id = ci.sku_id AND ci.sku_id <> '' WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND ci.store_id = #{storeId} AND ci.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY ci.update_time DESC, ci.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ck_shop_cart_item SET del_flag = 1, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND del_flag = 0
